VI.description: Keeps the status of every RemoteVI share of this LabVIEW application instance - a functional global (a Feedback Node outside any loop\2C initialized on the first call only\2C so the list survives between calls of this non-reentrant VI). Each server loop publishes its entry every 500 ms (publish? TRUE\2C RemoteVI Publish Status.vi) - the entry of the same port is replaced\2C a new port is appended - and removes it when it stops (remove? TRUE\2C entry of status's port). Neither\3A servers is the list as it is (RemoteVI Status.vi\2C RemoteVI Start.vi). Times are seconds since the LabVIEW epoch (Get Date/Time In Seconds). An entry whose server loop was aborted stays\2C but stops being updated\2C so RemoteVI Status.vi reports it as stopped after 2 s. Pure G\2C no I/O.

Control.description: TRUE stores status (replacing the entry of its port).
TRUE removes the entry of status's port.
